name: kudo-agents-workspace
description: npm workspace for the public Kudo packages (sdk, mcp, plugin-kudo) and the internal tools they share. kudo-agent/ keeps its own package.json and is not part of it.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @kudo-dev/sdk && npm run build -w @kudo-dev/mcp -w @kudo-dev/plugin-kudo
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @kudo-dev/sdk && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
